record.bible_text: The burden<WH04853> of Nineveh<WH05210>. The book<WH05612> of the vision<WH02377> of Nahum<WH05151> the Elkoshite<WH0512>.<CM>

God<WH0410> <FI>is<Fi> jealous<WH07072>, and the LORD<WH03068> revengeth<WH05358><WTH8802>; the LORD<WH03068> revengeth<WH05358><WTH8802>, and <FI>is<Fi> furious<WH01167><WH02534>; the LORD<WH03068> will take vengeance<WH05358><WTH8802> on his adversaries<WH06862>, and he reserveth<WH05201><WTH8802> <FI>wrath<Fi> for his enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>. <RF>God...: or, The LORD is a jealous God, and a revenger, etc<Rf> <RF>is furious: Heb. that hath fury<Rf>

The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> slow<WH0750> to anger<WH0639>, and great<WH01419> in power<WH03581>, and will not at all<WH05352><WTH8763> acquit<WH05352><WTH8762> <FI>the wicked<Fi> : the LORD<WH03068> hath his way<WH01870> in the whirlwind<WH05492> and in the storm<WH08183>, and the clouds<WH06051> <FI>are<Fi> the dust<WH080> of his feet<WH07272>.

He rebuketh<WH01605><WTH8802> the sea<WH03220>, and maketh it dry<WH02717><WTH8689>, and drieth up<WH03001><WTH8762> all the rivers<WH05104>: Bashan<WH01316> languisheth<WH0535><WTH8797>, and Carmel<WH03760>, and the flower<WH06525> of Lebanon<WH03844> languisheth<WH0535><WTH8797>.

The mountains<WH02022> quake<WH07493><WTH8804> at him, and the hills<WH01389> melt<WH04127><WTH8712>, and the earth<WH0776> is burned<WH05375><WTH8799> at his presence<WH06440>, yea, the world<WH08398>, and all that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> therein.

Who can stand<WH05975><WTH8799> before<WH06440> his indignation<WH02195>? and who can abide<WH06965><WTH8799> in the fierceness<WH02740> of his anger<WH0639>? his fury<WH02534> is poured out<WH05413><WTH8738> like fire<WH0784>, and the rocks<WH06697> are thrown down<WH05422><WTH8738> by him. <RF>abide: Heb. stand up<Rf>

The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> good<WH02896>, a strong hold<WH04581> in the day<WH03117> of trouble<WH06869>; and he knoweth<WH03045><WTH8802> them that trust<WH02620><WTH8802> in him. <RF>strong hold: or, strength<Rf>

But with an overrunning<WH05674><WTH8802> flood<WH07858> he will make<WH06213><WTH8799> an utter end<WH03617> of the place<WH04725> thereof, and darkness<WH02822> shall pursue<WH07291><WTH8762> his enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>.<CM>
What do ye imagine<WH02803><WTH8762> against the LORD<WH03068>? he will make<WH06213><WTH8802> an utter end<WH03617>: affliction<WH06869> shall not rise up<WH06965><WTH8799> the second time<WH06471>.

For while <FI>they be<Fi> folden together<WH05440><WTH8803> <FI>as<Fi> thorns<WH05518>, and while they are drunken<WH05433><WTH8803> <FI>as<Fi> drunkards<WH05435>, they shall be devoured<WH0398><WTH8795> as stubble<WH07179> fully<WH04392> dry<WH03002>.

There is <FI>one<Fi> come out<WH03318><WTH8804> of thee, that imagineth<WH02803><WTH8802> evil<WH07451> against the LORD<WH03068>, a wicked<WH01100> counsellor<WH03289><WTH8802>. <RF>a wicked...: Heb. a counsellor of Belial<Rf>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; Though <FI>they be<Fi> quiet<WH08003>, and likewise many<WH07227>, yet thus shall they be cut down<WH01494><WTH8738>, when he shall pass through<WH05674><WTH8804>. Though I have afflicted<WH06031><WTH8765> thee, I will afflict<WH06031><WTH8762> thee no more. <RF>Though...: or, If they would have been at peace, so should they have been many, and so should they have been shorn, and he should have passed away<Rf> <RF>cut down: Heb. shorn<Rf>
For now will I break<WH07665><WTH8799> his yoke<WH04132> from off thee, and will burst<WH05423><WH00> thy bonds<WH04147> in sunder<WH05423><WTH8762>.

And the LORD<WH03068> hath given a commandment<WH06680><WTH8765> concerning thee, <FI>that<Fi> no more of thy name<WH08034> be sown<WH02232><WTH8735>: out of the house<WH01004> of thy gods<WH0430> will I cut off<WH03772><WTH8686> the graven image<WH06459> and the molten image<WH04541>: I will make<WH07760><WTH8799> thy grave<WH06913>; for thou art vile<WH07043><WTH8804>.

Behold upon the mountains<WH02022> the feet<WH07272> of him that bringeth good tidings<WH01319><WTH8764>, that publisheth<WH08085><WTH8688> peace<WH07965>! O Judah<WH03063>, keep<WH02287><WTH8798> thy solemn feasts<WH02282>, perform<WH07999><WTH8761> thy vows<WH05088>: for the wicked<WH01100> shall no more<WH03254><WTH8686> pass through<WH05674><WTH8800> thee; he is utterly cut off<WH03772><WTH8738>. <RF>keep...: Heb. feast<Rf> <RF>the wicked: Heb. Belial<Rf><CM>
